requirements.title: Use an edition-specific integration contract
requirements.trigger: Selecting or changing an ATS/payroll adapter
requirements.required_behavior: Record the product/version, authorized fields, operations, scopes, supported test method and export path before enabling writes.
requirements.exception: Missing entitlement or ambiguous write semantics keeps the adapter simulated or read-only within allowed scope.
requirements.acceptance: A required unavailable operation produces a failed conformance result, not a claimed working connector.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed behavior based on vendor documentation

requirements.title: Verify applicable AI integration permission
requirements.trigger: Connecting an agent to a vendor service
requirements.required_behavior: Record the governing agreement and approved AI/data purpose for the actual selected product.
requirements.exception: Unresolved terms prevent enabling that use; do not infer access from another customer's account or generic API availability.
requirements.acceptance: Configuration requires a dated permission/terms decision for the actual vendor/product.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed gate informed by published vendor policy

requirements.title: Match screening order to permitted package and consent
requirements.required_behavior: Use provider identity, applicable school package, consent evidence and an approved transaction; store a restricted report reference.
requirements.exception: Wrong package, missing authority or mismatch routes to review and must not auto-order or auto-reject.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate order retries cannot create a second charge and incomplete authority prevents submission.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed design; legal requirements separately mapped in obligations

requirements.title: Keep actual work, service evidence and billing separate
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain independent worked-time and contract-billable calculations, with original records, unit types and versioned corrections.
requirements.exception: Invoice rejection cannot by itself suppress worked-time evaluation or earned-pay processing.
requirements.acceptance: A disputed service/invoice line leaves the corresponding pay preparation independently reviewable.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed operating requirement; source-specific contract and obligations pack constrain implementation

requirements.title: Make external actions idempotent and reconcilable
requirements.trigger: Write, retry or uncertain vendor response
requirements.required_behavior: Persist operation key, payload/version hash and external acknowledgment. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying a non-idempotent operation.
requirements.exception: Timeout is not evidence of failure; retain unknown state with an owner.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated identical actions produce one business effect; changed payload under the same key is rejected.

requirements.title: Bind approval to the exact action
requirements.actor: Named district, clinical, employment or financial approver
requirements.required_behavior: Store actor, scope, payload hash, record versions, policy version, expiry and revocation state; block stale approvals.
requirements.exception: Any material change requires new approval by the appropriate owner.
requirements.acceptance: A changed rate, recipient, evidence version or amount invalidates the earlier approval.

requirements.title: Minimize school data and isolate tenants
requirements.actor: District privacy owner and platform owner
requirements.trigger: Any import, search, export or message
requirements.required_behavior: Enforce approved field purposes and role/district boundaries server-side. Keep clinical and IEP content in the school-designated record system for this initial scope.
requirements.exception: Even opaque student references require approved access and handling; unapproved content is quarantined or excluded.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-district requests and general recruiter access to student service content fail without leaking data in results or logs.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed design; FERPA applicability addressed in obligations

requirements.title: Version district rules and resolve conflicts
requirements.trigger: New order, amendment or conflicting instruction
requirements.required_behavior: Record source, effective interval, scope, approved interpretation and precedence for each rule; recalculate only affected records.
requirements.exception: Conflicting percentages, units or deadlines remain unresolved until the owner confirms the governing rule.
requirements.acceptance: Two incompatible clauses create a visible blocked configuration item; the agent cannot choose the more convenient one.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed design; public district examples are requirements evidence only

requirements.title: Plan workload beyond direct service minutes
requirements.required_behavior: Include approved direct service, assessment, documentation, meetings, supervision, travel and other duties in the workload profile.
requirements.exception: Do not infer universal capacity from a student count or assume all paid work is a therapy session.
requirements.acceptance: An apparently free session slot is rejected or reviewed when approved indirect duties or travel consume that capacity.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed system behavior informed by professional guidance

requirements.title: Apply discipline and school qualifications independently
requirements.required_behavior: Evaluate the selected discipline, provider/assistant level, state/SEA requirements, supervision and district acceptance with dated evidence.
requirements.exception: A professional certificate alone is not assumed to meet every state or district requirement; nursing verification cannot clear therapists.
requirements.acceptance: A provider qualified for one role or district is not automatically marked ready for another.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed design informed by provider qualification guidance

requirements.title: Keep district invoicing distinct from Medicaid claims
requirements.required_behavior: Produce district staffing invoices under executed terms. Treat any Medicaid claiming product as a separate future decision with state/program/provider/documentation requirements.
requirements.exception: An invoice, service record or professional license is not treated as proof of Medicaid claim eligibility.
requirements.acceptance: The initial product has no enabled Medicaid claim submission route and labels its financial outputs as district invoices.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed scope decision informed by CMS guidance structure

requirements.title: Treat imported documents as evidence, not commands
requirements.trigger: Uploaded resume, contract, message or school-system content
requirements.required_behavior: Keep extracted facts separate from action instructions. Only validated application commands and approved policy can authorize an action.
requirements.exception: Embedded instructions to alter recipients, rates, credentials or permissions are ignored and flagged.
requirements.acceptance: A hostile instruction in a synthetic document cannot change an approved rate, export data or grant access.

requirements.title: Set measurable operational and recovery targets
requirements.required_behavior: Agree response coverage, access revocation timing, recovery time, recovery point, expected peak volume and reconciled error-handling targets; measure them against the implementation.
requirements.exception: Unset targets and untested recovery remain open readiness items.
requirements.acceptance: A vendor-outage and restoration drill preserves pending work and reconciles delayed events without duplicate financial effects.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed nonfunctional requirement; thresholds not yet selected

requirements.title: Define retention, offboarding and export by data class
requirements.actor: District privacy owner and operator records owner
requirements.trigger: Provisioning, contract end or deletion request
requirements.required_behavior: Assign an approved retention schedule and hold rules separately to staffing, education, screening, financial and audit records; revoke access and reconcile exports at offboarding.
requirements.exception: Do not use one invented retention period or remove held records automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic offboarding revokes the right access, exports only authorized records and preserves items under an applicable hold.
requirements.evidence_status: Proposed design; jurisdiction and contract review pending
